import numpy as np

A, H = 1.0, 1.0
Q, R = 0.01, 0.25
xhat, P = 0.0, 1.0  # prior mean and variance
u = 0.0             # no control

zs = [1.2, 0.9, 1.1, 1.0, 0.95]
for z in zs:
    # Predict
    xhat = A*xhat + 0*u
    P = A*P*A + Q
    # Update
    S = H*P*H + R
    K = P*H / S
    xhat = xhat + K*(z - H*xhat)
    P = (1 - K*H)*P
    print(f"z={z:.2f}  xhat={xhat:.3f}  P={P:.3f}")
